approach: Derive selected decisions; do not install or wrap a broad donor.
scope: All 19 user-supplied repositories from this conversation received current SSH acquisition and a complete tracked-path inventory. Text screening covered skill, agent, rule and development-doc sources beyond named entrypoints; selected files were read as recorded. This is not a line-by-line review of every repository file.

corpus.selection: Markdown/mdc/mdx/rst/txt plus candidate pipeline configuration and license files. ECC: canonical skills/rules/agents/commands/docs/.github; agent-skills-standard: skills/docs/.github; LobeHub: .agents/.cursor/.claude/docs/development/.github/scripts; root text included. Other repositories: complete instruction-text path corpus. No application-code audit is claimed.
corpus.search: rg --hidden --no-ignore with .git excluded: CI/CD, CI CD, continuous integration/delivery/deployment, build once, artifact promotion, pipeline, rollback, CI workflow/failure/check, deployment/deploying; supplemented by tracked-path matching for CI, release, deployment and verification.

contract: Provider-independent stage structure, evidence and trust boundaries, artifact promotion, delivery criteria, recovery and measured efficiency.

boundaries.github-actions: GitHub workflow, permissions, event and runner mechanics

donors.author: Addy Osmani
borrowed: Place automated checks before the decisions they protect and make failures actionable.
Separate deployment from feature exposure; keep delivery feedback short.
local_choices: Choose applicable checks from the product contract instead of a universal JavaScript gate list, fixed environment chain, time target, review count or merge policy.
Keep GitHub YAML, dependency bots, PR repair and credentials mechanics with their existing owners.
Replace the claim that every deployment is reversible with explicit data and external-effect recovery.

donors.author: Seth Hobson / wshobson
borrowed: Design stage dependencies, artifact promotion, rollout criteria and post-deployment verification together.
Account for old and new consumers during schema transitions and choose rollout patterns from product constraints.
local_choices: Keep provider examples, Kubernetes commands and platform-specific troubleshooting outside the general skill.
Do not promise automatic rollback, instant recovery, zero downtime, mandatory staging or fixed DORA thresholds.
Treat inconclusive telemetry explicitly; an Argo inconclusive result pauses and is not equivalent to a failed analysis.
Verify any target-specific rebuild as its own artifact and bind promotion evidence to the actual candidate.

donors.author: Matthew Blode
borrowed: Measure the critical path using real run timing, including setup, queue time, variance and runner cost.
Preserve coverage when filtering, sharding or caching; cover unverified changes and detect silently missing workspace tasks.
Separate safely cancellable validation from deployment with shared mutable state.
local_choices: Load efficiency guidance only for topology, filtering, caching or performance changes.
Do not import timing scripts, hosted-runner prices, published speedup numbers, fixed timing targets, test-runner flags, mandatory ledger or automatic pushes.
Check all relevant cache inputs and trust domains; no universal cache or cancellation recipe.

donors.author: Every / Compound Engineering
borrowed: Name data invariants, concrete pre/post-deployment observations, recovery limits and the operational owner.
Distinguish code rollback from data restoration and irreversible effects.
local_choices: Use conditional delivery guidance rather than a second code-review persona or mandatory SQL checklist.
Choose observation windows and thresholds from service requirements, not the example five-minute/24-hour schedule.
Verify restore feasibility and allowed data loss; a backup alone does not prove recovery.

donors.author: Lauren Tan / pstack
borrowed: Reconcile partial prior effects before retries; define the outcome of repeated or interrupted operations.
Isolate independent mutable targets and enforce serialization structurally when one shared target is a real invariant.
local_choices: Apply the principles to deployment targets, migrations and shared build resources; do not import PID-lock recipes or universal self-healing.
Reject obsolete candidates as well as overlapping writes. Existing authorization still governs deployment and recovery.
Keep pstack shipping, code verification and CI babysitting procedures with the corresponding local owners.

primaryReferences.title: DORA: Continuous delivery
primaryReferences.usedFor: Separates releasability from automatic deployment; no universal environment topology.

primaryReferences.title: DORA: Continuous integration
primaryReferences.usedFor: Fast feedback, authoritative repeatable packages and tests before and after integration.

primaryReferences.title: DORA: Deployment automation
primaryReferences.usedFor: Promote the tested package, separate configuration, verify actual deployment and retain an auditable release state.

primaryReferences.title: SLSA 1.2: Verifying artifacts
primaryReferences.usedFor: A provenance record must be checked against the artifact, trusted builder and expected build parameters.

primaryReferences.title: OWASP: CI/CD Security Cheat Sheet
primaryReferences.usedFor: Pipeline stages and their credentials/resources require explicit trust and least-privilege boundaries. Its blanket merge policy is not adopted.

primaryReferences.title: Google SRE Workbook: Canarying releases
primaryReferences.usedFor: Canary evaluation needs a meaningful exposure, observation and promotion decision; merely waiting is not proof.

primaryReferences.title: Argo Rollouts: Inconclusive runs
primaryReferences.usedFor: Cross-check for an upstream troubleshooting overclaim: inconclusive analysis pauses a rollout; it is not automatically a failed rollout.

primaryReferences.title: Prisma: Patching and hotfixing
primaryReferences.usedFor: Cross-check for ECC: migrate resolve updates migration history; reverting applied database changes is separate work.
